home_section_main_banner_content_h1: HyperBPO & Digital Transformation Solutions for Businesses
home_section_main_banner_content_p: HyperBPO provides document and data digitization services for businesses, organizations, and government agencies. We aim to become a long-term partner in digitalization services, where all traditional data, records, and processes are transformed into smart digital assets. We strive to build a modern digital ecosystem that enables businesses to maximize the value of information, improve operational efficiency, and expand opportunities for sustainable growth in the digital era.
data_entry_service_intro: Convert physical documents, including handwritten documents, printed materials, and spreadsheets, into digital formats through specialized data entry and data encoding processes, ensuring data integrity and optimal accessibility.
document_scanning_service_intro: Using professional scanning systems to convert various types of physical documents, including records, printed materials, and images, into popular digital formats such as PDF, TIFF, JPG, and PNG, meeting customers' required standards and output specifications.
document_adjusting_service_intro: Classifying records, determining their value, organizing and arranging documents, and compiling document inventories; while establishing a document retrieval system in accordance with the professional standards of the State Records and Archives Administration, ensuring systematic organization and optimal accessibility.
image_processing_service_intro: Our image processing services optimize visual assets used in publications, e-commerce, advertising content, brand promotion campaigns, and more. Image processing plays an important role in product presentation, advertising, and bringing products closer to customers.
data_labeling_service_intro: We provide solutions that transform raw data into valuable analytical information, creating a foundation for training applications on machine learning systems.
call_center_service_intro: We help you enhance customer experience, optimize operational efficiency, and reduce costs by maximizing the use of modern IT solutions for call center operations.

Organizing records systematically to facilitate effective document management, preservation, access, and utilization.
Eliminating documents that no longer have value for destruction, thereby improving the efficiency of storage facilities, equipment, and preservation resources.
document_adjusting_service_at_hyperbpo_c: Understanding the challenges businesses face during document arrangement, such as a lack of qualified personnel, limited knowledge of procedures, and insufficient equipment, HYPERBPO provides professional and high-quality document arrangement services that help customers save time and improve operational efficiency.

notice_detail:
HyperBPO Co., Ltd. (“HyperBPO,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) provides document digitization, data entry, data conversion, image processing, data labeling, and other BPO services to businesses, organizations, and partners both domestically and internationally.
In the course of providing our services, we may receive and process documents, records, data, and personal data provided by our customers.
HyperBPO understands that customer data and documents may contain important, confidential, or personal information relating to individuals. Therefore, we are committed to processing data strictly in accordance with the purposes, scope, and requirements agreed upon with our customers, while implementing appropriate measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of such data.
This Privacy Policy describes how HyperBPO collects, receives, uses, stores, protects, discloses, and processes information in connection with the operation of our website and the provision of our services.
collection_and_use_of_information_detail:
When you use the HyperBPO website or contact us, we may request certain information necessary to respond to your requests and provide our services, including:

  • Full name
  • Company or organization name
  • Job title or position
  • Telephone number
  • Email address
  • Contact address
  • Details of your inquiry
  • Information regarding your service requirements
  • Information provided during communications with us and
  • Other information necessary for consultation, quotation, contract execution, and service delivery.

We may use such information for the following purposes:

  • Receiving and responding to customer inquiries
  • Providing consultation regarding our services
  • Preparing quotations and service proposals
  • Communicating with customers
  • Negotiating, entering into, and performing contracts
  • Providing and managing services
  • Providing customer support
  • Managing customer relationships
  • Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
  • Protecting the legitimate rights and interests of HyperBPO and
  • Improving our services and website.

We do not use collected information for purposes that are inconsistent with the purposes disclosed or agreed upon, except where permitted or required by applicable law.
choices_and_data_processing_detail:
We collect and process information in accordance with applicable laws and the purposes disclosed to the relevant individual or agreed upon with the customer.
For data provided by customers for the purpose of performing our services, the collection and processing of such data may be carried out pursuant to:

  • Contracts and service agreements;
  • Data Processing Agreements (“DPAs”);
  • Requests or instructions from customers; and
  • Other lawful bases for processing as permitted by applicable law.

HyperBPO does not independently use data entrusted to us by customers for advertising, marketing, sales, or other purposes, nor provide such data to third parties, outside the scope authorized by the customer.
data_transfer_and_disclosure_detail:
HyperBPO does not sell, rent, or trade customers’ personal data to third parties for advertising purposes or for the commercialization of personal data.
Data may be disclosed or transferred in the following circumstances:

  • At the request or instruction of the customer
  • Within the scope of an applicable contract or service agreement
  • To service providers necessary for the performance of a project
  • For the operation and maintenance of information technology systems
  • For data storage, hosting, backup, or disaster recovery purposes
  • In response to a lawful request from a competent governmental authority
  • To comply with applicable legal or regulatory obligations
  • To protect the legitimate rights and interests of HyperBPO or
  • In other circumstances permitted by applicable law.

HyperBPO applies appropriate measures to require authorized parties who have access to customer data to comply with applicable confidentiality, information security, and data protection obligations.
security_detail:
HyperBPO is committed to protecting the personal data of customers and data subjects. We implement appropriate physical, technical, electronic, and organizational measures to protect such information against unauthorized access, use, disclosure, alteration, loss, or destruction.
Depending on the nature and sensitivity of the data and the requirements of each project, these measures may include, but are not limited to:

  • Firewalls
  • Intrusion detection and prevention mechanisms
  • Access controls and authentication mechanisms
  • Security monitoring systems
  • Data backup and recovery measures
  • Endpoint and network security measures and
  • Other appropriate security technologies and administrative controls.

Access to customer data is restricted to authorized personnel who require such access to perform their assigned duties.
data_integrity_detail:
HyperBPO is committed to maintaining the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and security of the data, documents, and information provided by our customers in connection with our services.
In providing document digitization, data entry, data conversion, document classification and arrangement, records management, and other BPO services, HyperBPO only receives, processes, stores, and transfers data in accordance with the purpose, scope, method, and retention period authorized or agreed upon by the customer.
We implement appropriate technical measures and operational control procedures to protect data during transmission between HyperBPO and our customers.
However, HyperBPO recognizes that no method of transmitting information over the Internet or storing electronic information can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Accordingly, while we make reasonable efforts to protect the data entrusted to us, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
access_rights_detail:
To the extent permitted by applicable law, data subjects may have the right to:

  • Access their personal data
  • Review their personal data
  • Request updates to their personal data
  • Request correction or rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Request deletion of their personal data
  • Request restriction of or object to certain processing activities and
  • Exercise other rights available under applicable law.

Requests may be submitted to:
Contact@hyperbpo.com
HyperBPO may request additional information as reasonably necessary to verify the identity of the requester and determine the scope of the requested rights.
Where HyperBPO processes data on behalf of a customer, requests concerning the correction, deletion, restriction, or other processing of such data may need to be handled in accordance with the
instructions of the customer or the party responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing.
compliance_and_enforcement_detail:
HyperBPO is committed to maintaining and implementing appropriate measures to protect the data, documents, and information provided by our customers in connection with our services.
Upon receiving a reasonable request from a customer relating to the review, assessment, or verification of data processing activities, HyperBPO will cooperate and provide relevant information to the extent permitted under the applicable contract, service agreement, and applicable law.
Any such cooperation will be conducted in a manner that does not compromise the confidentiality of other customers’ data or HyperBPO’s confidential internal information.
HyperBPO also maintains appropriate internal procedures for receiving, reviewing, investigating, and addressing complaints or concerns relating to data protection, information security, or the handling of customer data.
Where a security or data protection incident is identified, HyperBPO will take appropriate steps to assess the incident, mitigate its impact, implement corrective measures, and cooperate with the relevant customer where required.
cookies_detail:
The HyperBPO website may use cookies and similar technologies for the following purposes:


  • Maintaining website functionality
  • Remembering user preferences
  • Improving user experience and
  • Analyzing website performance and usage.
If you do not wish to allow cookies to be stored on your browser, you may configure your browser to reject cookies or notify you when a website attempts to place a cookie on your device.
However, disabling cookies may affect your ability to use certain features, products, or services available through our website.
Like most websites, we may automatically collect and store certain information in server or log files, including:
  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Internet Service Provider (ISP)
  • Referring and exit pages
  • Operating system
  • Date and time of access
  • Usage or behavioral data.

This information does not, by itself, directly identify a particular individual and may be used for purposes such as analyzing trends, administering the website, monitoring user activity, and collecting aggregated demographic information.
We do not intentionally combine automatically collected information with personally identifiable information for purposes inconsistent with this Privacy Policy.
legal_disclosure_detail:
HyperBPO will only provide, disclose, or transfer personal data, customer data, documents, or other information within the scope authorized by the customer, as agreed between the parties, or where disclosure is necessary to comply with applicable legal obligations.
Where a competent governmental or regulatory authority makes a lawful request for information, HyperBPO may disclose the relevant information to the extent and in accordance with the procedures required by applicable law.
HyperBPO does not use customer data, documents, or information for advertising, marketing, commercial exploitation, or other purposes outside the authorized scope, unless otherwise consented to by the customer or permitted or required by applicable law.
changes_to_this_privacy_policy_detail:
If we make changes to this Privacy Policy, we will update this Privacy Policy, our website homepage, or other appropriate locations to inform you about what information we collect, how we use it, and the circumstances under which we may disclose it.
HyperBPO reserves the right to amend or update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect and process information.
Where we make material changes, we may provide an appropriate notice on our website or through other reasonable means.
